translations.web: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.
translations.bsb: They cast lots for their duties, young and old alike, teacher as well as pupil.
translations.kjv: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
